classification.difficultyReason: Identify that 70 is Q3 for one class and the median for the other, convert to 25% and 50% of 24, then compare. Needs reading the right quartile marker per class, but the arithmetic is simple.

content.prompt: The parallel box plots show the marks of two classes on a test. Each class has 24 students.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many students in Class A scored more than 70 marks?

answer.worked:
$70$ is the upper quartile of Class A, so $25\%$ of the class scored more than $70$.
$$\begin{align*}25\%\times24&=6\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: How many students in Class B scored more than 70 marks?

answer.worked:
$70$ is the median of Class B, so $50\%$ of the class scored more than $70$.
$$\begin{align*}50\%\times24&=12\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Which class had more students scoring more than 70 marks?

answer.worked: Class B had $12$ students above $70$ marks, compared with $6$ students in Class A. Class B had more.
